destinations_days_range.name: destinations_days_range
destinations_days_range.value: "destinations"."suggested_days_min" IS NULL OR "destinations"."suggested_days_max" IS NULL OR "destinations"."suggested_days_min" <= "destinations"."suggested_days_max"

destinations_budget_currency.name: destinations_budget_currency
destinations_budget_currency.value: ("destinations"."daily_budget_low_minor" IS NULL AND "destinations"."daily_budget_mid_minor" IS NULL AND "destinations"."daily_budget_high_minor" IS NULL) OR "destinations"."budget_currency" IS NOT NULL

fees_shape.name: fees_shape
fees_shape.value:
("fees"."kind" = 'fixed' AND "fees"."amount_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "fees"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "fees"."basis_points" IS NULL)
       OR ("fees"."kind" = 'percent' AND "fees"."basis_points" IS NOT NULL AND "fees"."amount_minor" IS NULL)

price_rules_validity.name: price_rules_validity
price_rules_validity.value: "price_rules"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "price_rules"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "price_rules"."valid_from" <= "price_rules"."valid_to"

enquiries_travellers.name: enquiries_travellers
enquiries_travellers.value: "enquiries"."adults" BETWEEN 0 AND 99 AND "enquiries"."children" BETWEEN 0 AND 99 AND "enquiries"."adults" + "enquiries"."children" >= 1

enquiries_dates.name: enquiries_dates
enquiries_dates.value: "enquiries"."travel_from" IS NULL OR "enquiries"."travel_to" IS NULL OR "enquiries"."travel_from" <= "enquiries"."travel_to"

enquiries_budget.name: enquiries_budget
enquiries_budget.value: "enquiries"."budget_minor" IS NULL OR ("enquiries"."budget_minor" > 0 AND "enquiries"."budget_currency" IS NOT NULL)

consultation_services_price.name: consultation_services_price
consultation_services_price.value: "consultation_services"."price_minor" IS NULL OR ("consultation_services"."price_minor" > 0 AND "consultation_services"."currency" IS NOT NULL)
